To give you a rough idea, mainnet validator 0 (genesis) never went into sync committee.
https://beaconcha.in/validator/0

Sync committees were introduced in Altair (not genesis) and this validator has 32 effective balance, but it shows you sync committee participation is really rare, even for a 2048 ETH validator.
